title: Cricket data
description: Cricket players, teams and stats, explorable with Datasette.

players.description: Men's and women's international players. Full-text search available on names.

teams.description: International and domestic teams. Full-text search available on names.

formats.description: Formats of the game (Tests, ODIs, T20Is) referenced by stats.classId.

stats.description: International career stats by player and format.

most_test_runs.title: Most Test runs
most_test_runs.sql: select longName, gender, bat_matches, bat_innings, bat_runs, bat_average, bat_hundreds from stats where format = 'Tests' order by bat_runs desc limit 100

most_odi_runs.title: Most ODI runs
most_odi_runs.sql: select longName, gender, bat_matches, bat_innings, bat_runs, bat_average, bat_hundreds from stats where format = 'ODIs' order by bat_runs desc limit 100

most_t20i_runs.title: Most T20I runs
most_t20i_runs.sql: select longName, gender, bat_matches, bat_innings, bat_runs, bat_average, bat_strikeRate from stats where format = 'T20Is' order by bat_runs desc limit 100

most_test_wickets.title: Most Test wickets
most_test_wickets.sql: select longName, gender, bowl_matches, bowl_wickets, bowl_average, bowl_economy, bowl_fiveWickets from stats where format = 'Tests' order by bowl_wickets desc limit 100

best_test_batting_average.title: Best Test batting average (min 20 innings)
best_test_batting_average.sql: select longName, gender, bat_innings, bat_runs, bat_average, bat_hundreds from stats where format = 'Tests' and bat_innings >= 20 order by bat_average desc limit 100

best_test_bowling_average.title: Best Test bowling average (min 50 wickets)
best_test_bowling_average.sql: select longName, gender, bowl_matches, bowl_wickets, bowl_average, bowl_economy from stats where format = 'Tests' and bowl_wickets >= 50 order by bowl_average asc limit 100
